summary: Close mission person-step history waits on completion or cancellation and end retry intervals at their declared deadline

replay.detail: Read-time history folding only; no replay or recovery work.

schema.detail: No database tables, indexes, triggers, migrations or persistent data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, retention or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: Existing optional mission-history fields and event vocabulary are unchanged. Terminal person responses use the existing state event; retry wait end timestamps now respect the stored deadline.

downtime.detail: No additional startup work or interruption.

recovery.detail: No stored state changes; binary swap-back retains the same data and wire shapes.
